note: MODIFIER-BOUNDARY MINIMAL PAIRS. ⛔ This set exists to FALSIFY one specific hypothesis, not to measure accuracy. Eight triples. In each, the SAME subject, the SAME relation and the SAME hypothesis appear three times, differing only in WHERE the limitation lives.
hypothesis_under_test: A limit carried by a SATELLITE MODIFIER on an asserted relation (until · before · twice · three times · in 2019 · on Tuesday · during the trial period) is DROPPED. The same limit carried by the MAIN VERB's own form (no longer · stopped · used to · ceased · retired from · gave up · resigned as · left) is RESPECTED.

prediction_frozen_before_the_run.group_M: satellite modifier — predicted MISS (observed 'entailed' where not_entailed is expected)
prediction_frozen_before_the_run.group_P: licensed control — must be 'entailed', or conservatism explains everything else

falsification_conditions.hypothesis_survives: M negatives fail materially more often than V negatives, and P is near-perfect
falsification_conditions.hypothesis_refuted_narrow: M and V both pass — the defect is narrower than the encoding and the five earlier misses need another explanation
falsification_conditions.hypothesis_refuted_broad: M and V both fail — the defect is cessation/limitation in general, and WHERE the boundary lives is irrelevant
falsification_conditions.hypothesis_unreadable: P fails — the verifier went conservative and no negative column means anything

freeze: Frozen at commit, prediction included. ⛔ The prediction is part of the frozen artifact: a hypothesis recorded only after seeing the result is not a hypothesis.
label_rule: The verdict is ENTAILED vs NOT ENTAILED. `neutral` and `contradiction` are recorded diagnostics only.
